title: CS2 World Bundle surface index (terrain/surfaces/index.json, contract section 8)
description: Maps each id in terrain/surface_index.png to a name and a representative texture. The raster is IDS, NOT COLOURS — 8-bit grayscale whose values are keys into this file. Id 0 is ground the game classifies procedurally (grass/dirt/rock by slope and noise); id 1 is road-flattened ground, which in-game reads as dirt under the lane decals' wear tint. This is the SEMANTIC roadbed mask — physics, the sink rule — not the visual one: where terrain/splatmap.png is present a consumer should prefer it for appearance, and per-cell classification from this raster is only the documented fallback. A cut cell's id is meaningless, because the cell is not drawn at all (section 8c).

propertyNames.description: The raster value, as a decimal string. 8-bit, so 0..255.

name.description: What the id means. 'natural' and 'roadbed' are the two the producer emits.

texture.description: A bundle-root-relative PNG that stands for this surface, or NULL when the theme texture could not be read. Representative only — the real ground appearance is the splatmap blend over terrain/surfaces/*.png (section 8), not one texture per id.
